_doc: Tuning for Norppa. Level n: board size = min(maxSize, baseSize + floor((n-1)/sizeGrowEvery)); target par = min(maxPar, minPar + floor((n-1)*parGrowth)); accepted par is target..target+parSlack. Densities are per-cell chances. Snow appears from snowFromLevel. Stars: 3 at par, 2 within starSlack extra moves, else 1. Slide speed in ms per cell, clamped. Changing seedSalt reshuffles every level.
